readout.notes: Author playground server (--backend torch) answers POST /v1/systemone from the PyTorch model with the adapter's decision readout and calibration.json. Not an OpenAI-style completions endpoint.
readout.portable_notes: Best portable path: same-author MLX adapter/readout at mohit67890/imajev-4b@c9e5f132465da85d31735ec502d5557982671a7d, with pinned frozen Qwen3.5-4B base; original author MLXDirect reads the decision head directly (not mlx_lm server). https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohit67890/imajev/8501f5c3b1ed8ef608744eabed40f22b70de4277/src/vision_decision/backend.py L16: from mlx_vlm import load; L22: self.model, self.processor = load(self.bundle["path"], trust_remote_code=False); L24: from mlx_vlm.trainer.utils import apply_lora_layers; L31: if adapter is not None:. CPU/MPS Torch fallback is also unmodified, but FP32, not BF16: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohit67890/imajev/8501f5c3b1ed8ef608744eabed40f22b70de4277/scripts/playground/server.py L119: device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "mps" if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu"; L124: dtype = torch.bfloat16 if device == "cuda" and not float32 else torch.float32; L130: self.engine = TorchDecision(self.bundle["path"], "cpu" if merge else device, dtype=torch.float32 if merge else dtype,. Explicit --backend mlx is necessary; auto selection checks a development MLX_ADAPTER directory rather than the passed adapter. Backend_agnostic=false: both implementations read logits/head in-process. MLX/BF16 needs roughly 12.3 GB + OS; FP32 Torch roughly 24.5 GB + OS. Portable runtime and parity not re-tested here.

image_input.limits: 0-2 images, resized to at most 400,000 pixels; state up to 32 KB; 1-8 questions; at most 4,096 tokens (refused, not truncated); English only

variants.expected_speed: About 0.11 s raw p 50 per decision on the BH measurement box (0.37 s after the frozen speed adjustment). One prefill per question, up to 4,096 input tokens. Provisioning class: RTX 4090 24 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: Min VRAM 12 GB = 9.3 GB Qwen3.5-4B BF16 safetensors + 0.49 GB adapter_model.safetensors + ~2 GB for activations/KV at 4,096 tokens and two images (derived; BH serve.sh passes no merge flag, the fastlane setup uses --merge-lora). Author/intake estimate ~10 GB. RAM not measured. The fastlane receipt records 4B BF16 weights with a fused server setup; exact peak VRAM not found. Non-benchmarked MLX adapter (mlx/adapters.safetensors) exists on the same repo but needs an MLX base conversion we did not identify, so it is not listed. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 9.810 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 16 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.
